assessment: A-level tool-first page for "meta robots" (1000/mo, KD 47): the Meta Robots Checker is the first screen, the 46-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "x-robots-tag", "x robots tag" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "meta robots" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Robots meta tag and X-Robots-Tag directives; conflicting rules resolve to the more restrictive; disallowed URLs cannot show indexing rules.
Robots.txt spec: 500 KiB limit, 4xx = no restrictions, 5xx = stop 12h then last good copy up to 30 days, least restrictive rule wins, crawl-delay unsupported, 24h cache.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (3 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 380 words, 2 Pexels images, 2 inline source links, 3 internal links, 3 FAQs, 4 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) from the raw files in /public/resources.
